uncertainties: Epic has locked the roster at 162 entries for Override (season ends Oct 31 2026), but a mid-season content change could still add or remove rows. The tracker carries a catalogVersion so imported collections stay matched to the roster they were recorded against.

The mastery thresholds for the five Quack Sprites (40/45/50/55/60) and the 70-mastery Pixel Polli style come from multiple guides that agree with each other; Epic has not published the numbers in patch notes. Treat them as report-consistent, not officially documented.

There is no Jonesy 'Spirit' sub-family in the game. Jonesy has exactly seven collection rows: Base, Gold, Cheat Master, Loot Hacker, Bounty Hunter, Trick or Treat and Quack (the Quack form is a 40-mastery reward). Names such as 'Golden Jonesy Spirit', 'King of Cheats Jonesy Spirit' or 'Pirate of Plunder Jonesy Spirit' do not appear in any verified Season 4 source and were therefore NOT added to the catalog.
The game calls these collectibles 'Sprites'; this tracker accepts 'spirit'/'spirits' in search as a synonym but uses the official names in the catalog.
Exact drop rates per Sprite are not published by Epic, so none are shown.

Some trackers still list pre-launch or cancelled rows (Jazz Jackrabbit, Bushranger, 8-Bit Blaster, The Adventurer, Victory Crown, Bullet, Cube, Head Shot, Meowscles, Squibbly) and previous-season Sprites (Dream, Zero Point, Grim Reaper, Ironmouse, Pollo, Duck, Ghost, Fire, Water, Earth, Fishy). Only the 27 Sprites actually obtainable in Season 4 are in this catalog; the older names are wired into search as aliases.
Chapter 7 Season 3 Sprites stay in a player's collection but are no longer equippable and do not feed the Season 4 mastery track, so they are out of scope for this tracker.
